portfolio_assessment: Honest baseline: P(decide RH in months) is approximately zero for ANY slate; the meaningful objective is maximizing field-defining results while keeping a real option on a decision, and against that metric this slate is strong but structurally lopsided. Six of the seven survivors (A2, A3, A4, B2, B3, B4) are re-instantiations of the single Zeta23 rank-trace certificate in new coordinates — higher moments, families, windows, flow time, jets — which makes them a correlated-failure block: one adverse meta-theorem (e.g. a cubic extension of lemmaR_tight, which the merged A2/A4 LP could itself produce) would degrade four directions at once. Meanwhile the sponsor's headline track is down to a single survivor (C2) after C1's refutation, and the slate's coverage of S4's four positivity-generator classes is: analytic (C2, partially), algebraic (empty), combinatorial (empty), probabilistic (empty) — i.e. the program is majority-invested in exactly the 'advance existing machinery' mode the directive subordinates. The refutation hedge is well-organized (B2) but has no execution arm, and the only historically successful RH-proving mechanism (Hodge index) plus the only proven modern positivity generator (functoriality) are both absent. THE SINGLE CHANGE THAT MOST IMPROVES P: merge A2 and A4 into one cubic-certificate direction (they are one bet with two supply lines) and spend the freed design slot on a second Track-C direction built on the unrepresented generators — the arithmetic-geometry/functoriality axis (Connes-Consani Spec-Z Hodge-index interface and/or Rankin-Selberg functoriality positivity as the S1 input), designed under C1's adjudicated repairs (ghost term mandatory, containment theorem first, no naive tilted EF). That one restructuring removes the largest redundancy, halves the correlated-failure exposure, and restores two independent shots on the track where both the directive and the sponsor's probability mass sit. Second-most-valuable change, if one more is allowed: stand up the computational/certified Lambda>0 and wanted-poster search arm — the only channel in reach that could literally decide RH (negatively) within the program's horizon, and the natural exploitation of this program's unique formal-verification DNA.
